table_id.title: Table Id
table_id.description: The id of the table written.

path.title: Path
path.description: The code table file, relative to the node.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: The new revision of the file.

previous_revision.title: Previous Revision
previous_revision.description: The revision before the save, or null for a new table.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The counts of the change written.

400.description: The node is not a Data Map node, or the body is malformed (bad_input).

404.description: Node not found, or no code table with that id (no_table).

409.description: The file changed since the preview (stale), the result differs (changed), or the node follows a catalog (catalog_linked).

422.description: The code table file can't be read (unreadable), with the reader's line.
